hakuin.oneLineZh: 江户临济禅中兴人物，以公案训练体系重整禅门修行路径。
hakuin.oneLineEn: Edo Rinzai Zen revival figure who reorganized practice paths through a koan training system.

honen.oneLineZh: 日本净土宗开派人物，以专修念佛重组净土信仰之传统。
honen.oneLineEn: Founding figure of Japanese Pure Land, remaking the tradition around exclusive nembutsu practice.

kukai.oneLineZh: 日本真言宗开派人物，连接唐代密教与日本佛教之制度。
kukai.oneLineEn: Founding figure of Japanese Shingon, linking Tang esoteric Buddhism to Japanese institutions.

ito-jinsai.oneLineZh: 江户古学派代表人物，主张回到孔孟文本并批评朱子学。
ito-jinsai.oneLineEn: Edo Ancient Learning figure urging return to Confucius-Mencius texts against Zhu Xi learning.

jeong-yakyong.oneLineZh: 朝鲜实学重镇人物，重释经学并发展经世政治之思想路径。
jeong-yakyong.oneLineEn: Major Joseon Silhak figure re-reading classics and developing statecraft political thought.

wonhyo.oneLineZh: 朝鲜佛教代表人物，以和诤思想统合不同教义之系统结构。
wonhyo.oneLineEn: Korean Buddhist figure unifying divergent doctrinal systems through reconciling-disputes thought.

ogyu-sorai.oneLineZh: 江户儒学代表人物，以古文辞学和礼乐制度论批评朱子学。
ogyu-sorai.oneLineEn: Edo Confucian criticizing Zhu Xi via ancient rhetoric learning and ritual-music institutional theory.

seo-gyeongdeok.oneLineZh: 朝鲜儒学气一元论人物，连接张载气论与退溪语境脉络。
seo-gyeongdeok.oneLineEn: Joseon qi-monism Confucian linking Zhang Zai's qi theory with the Toegye scholarly context.

kapila-ishvarakrishna.oneLineZh: 以《数论颂》系统化数论派二元论与三德的基本理论框架。
kapila-ishvarakrishna.oneLineEn: Systematizes Sāṃkhya dualism and the three guṇas as basic theory in the Sāṃkhya-kārikā.

vivekananda.oneLineZh: 新吠檀多与印度现代宗教思想向全球传播的关键枢纽人物。
vivekananda.oneLineEn: Key hub transmitting Neo-Vedānta and modern Indian religious thought across the globe.

udayana.oneLineZh: 正理派代表人物，系统论证神存在并回应佛教哲学批评。
udayana.oneLineEn: Nyāya figure systematically arguing for God and answering Buddhist philosophical critiques.

buton.oneLineZh: 藏传佛教史家，并在大藏经编定过程中起关键组织作用。
buton.oneLineEn: Tibetan Buddhist historian and key organizer in the process of compiling the Buddhist canon.

gampopa.oneLineZh: 达波噶举开派人物，融合噶当道次第与大手印之传统路径。
gampopa.oneLineEn: Founding Dakpo Kagyu figure fusing Kadampa stages of the path with Mahāmudrā tradition.

sakya-pandita.oneLineZh: 萨迦派系统家，以《量理宝藏论》推进藏传量论之传统。
sakya-pandita.oneLineEn: Sakya systematizer advancing Tibetan pramāṇa via Treasury of Reasoning on Valid Cognition.

joseph-albo.oneLineZh: 《信条书》作者，系统重整犹太教义原则与信仰分类体系。
joseph-albo.oneLineEn: Author of Sefer ha-Ikkarim, systematically reorganizing Jewish doctrinal principles and faith categories.
